title: French Creamy Pudding Dessert
description: A classic French dessert made with silky pudding and milk, perfect for any occasion.

ingredients.name: juicy
ingredients.notes: Unknown ingredient, assuming fruit or gelatin

instructions: Combine silk or pudding, milk, and sugar in a medium saucepan.
Whisk until smooth and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat and stir in Croatian pudding, if using.
Allow the mixture to cool to room temperature.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Serve chilled, garnished with fresh fruit or a sprinkle of sugar.
